decisionsTitle: «PR Kit» in the backoffice for every role: the logo kit, the sticker sheets and the YouTube poster, drawn by the platform
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-20**, of the logo kit, the sticker sheets and the YouTube poster made for him by hand that night: «also put them in the backoffice website and call it "PR Kit" so we can download it at any time, even the volunteers can do that». The approved designs were HTML drawn by Chromium, outside the platform; the site had the club's lockup (`public/brand/logo.svg`, framed 13 units round its drawing) and the rasters `yarn brand:assets` makes for the PDFs and the emails (§174, §885), and no way for anybody on the team to take the logo away in a shape a print shop or Canva wants.

**Decision — «PR Kit», a section of the backoffice's top bar for every role.** `prKit` in `ADMIN_SECTIONS`, just before «Ghid», offered to `canWorkTheDesk` — every backoffice role, the desk's Voluntar included, never a club member — so the volunteer's bar is «Ziua cursei», «PR Kit», «Ghid». The page `/admin/pr-kit` asks `requireStaff` (the team's undertaking, §1006, stands in front of it as in front of every page) and `canWorkTheDesk`, else not found; its three routes ask the same on the server (`modules/pr-kit/http.ts`): no session `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401), a role that may not or a colleague who owes the undertaking `FORBIDDEN` (403) (BR-REQ-060-01). Each route is a GET that writes nothing and hands out an attachment named from the club's slug, `Cache-Control: private, no-store`. The tab wears `ACTION_ICONS.prKit` (Material's Style: a brand's swatches and brush); the four cards their own glyphs.

**Decision — «Logo»: two shapes × three inks × SVG, PNG and PDF.** The whole lockup and its mountains alone, each in the palette's primary, in white and in black, drawn as a tile on the ground it is meant for (the white one on the primary). `yarn brand:assets` writes the SVGs and PNGs into `public/brand/kit/` (`scripts/brand-kit.mjs`): the drawing **measured from its own path data** — every segment's ends, every Bézier's and arc's turning points, under the group's translation: this lockup is 73.04 → 2926.96 across and 918.77 → 2081.23 down, what a raster at a unit a pixel read as 73 → 2927 and 918 → 2082 — framed 4 % of its width out on every side, written 200 mm wide with its height spelled out, so no viewer clips the last «S». **The mountains are the paths `club.json`'s `logo.mark.viewBox` shows whole** (here the first; the runners start a unit below the mark's frame), so a fork's lockup picks its own. The PNG is 4000 pixels wide on a transparent ground, drawn from the same SVG sized in pixels — sharp 0.35's librsvg applied the density twice to a size in millimetres. The files are named from the slug (`<slug>-logo-primary.svg`, `<slug>-mountains-white-4000px.png`), their inks are the palette's (`PR_KIT_COLOURS` in `brand.ts`), and `club/assets.lock.json` holds each file's sha256 beside the sources' and the primary: a source, a colour or a kit file changed without the script fails `brand-assets-lock.test.ts`, and `brand-kit.test.ts` holds each committed SVG equal to what the script writes from today's lockup. **The PDF is vector**: pdfkit draws the SVG's own paths with `doc.path()` under its translation, on a page the SVG's size. The site's own two SVGs keep their tight frames: a browser draws the whole `viewBox` (13 units round the lockup, 6 under the mark), so nothing on the site clips.

**Decision — «Autocolante»: the six approved A4 sheets, drawn on request.** «12 pe foaie» with a code (3 × 4, upright: the logo, a 34 mm code, the site's address) and «24 pe foaie» (3 × 8, lying down: the logo and the address left, a 24 mm code right), whose codes lead to this site from `APP_BASE_URL` and print the address without its scheme, `www.` or closing slash; the logo alone 12, 24 and 40 to a sheet and 12 white on the primary. Margins 9 mm at the sides and 8 at the top and foot, the stickers tiling the rest, a light-grey dashed line on every cut — white on the primary. Every code is error correction M, drawn module by module from `qrcode`'s matrix, with **a quiet zone of four modules inside each sticker, clear of the logo and the address, for every code from version 1 up** (the geometry is pure, `domain/sheets.ts`); the logo is the kit's vector paths, fitted by its proportion, so a squarer lockup stays inside the sticker.

**Decision — «Afiș YouTube»: the approved A4 poster, only while the club's channel is set.** The logo; «Suntem pe» over YouTube's red play button beside «YouTube»; «Cursele, antrenamentele și oamenii din club — urmărește-ne și abonează-te!»; the code to `CLUB_YOUTUBE_URL` (error correction Q) in a white card framed in the primary with a «SCANEAZĂ-MĂ» tab on its edge; «Deschide camera telefonului și îndreapt-o spre cod»; the address without its scheme; the club's hashtags from `club.json`; a rounded frame in the primary 7 mm in. Its words are the catalogue's (`Admin.prKit.poster.*`), in the page's language. Unset, the route is not found and the page says in one line where the address goes (`CLUB_YOUTUBE_URL`, the Vercel project's variables, then redeploy).

**Decision — «Culori».** The palette's primary as hex and RGB, a swatch, and one sentence: on paper it comes out a little darker than on screen; ask the print shop to match it to the logo. No colour or club word is written in the code: the palette, the slug and the hashtags come through `brand.ts`.

**Refused.** Drawing the PDFs with Chromium, as the designs were: a browser in a serverless function is the one native dependency `brand:assets` exists to keep out of `next build` (§174). The site's Inter for the poster: fontkit fails to subset its WOFF2 files (composite glyphs), so the PDFs set their words in the Roboto the bibs and the badges use. The approved poster's 94 mm code with a 6 mm margin — two modules: the code is as large as a four-module quiet zone lets it be inside the card, about 90 mm for a channel's address, the card a little taller so the tab never reaches into the zone. Linking the SVGs and PNGs straight to `public/brand/kit/`: every download goes through a route that asks the role on the server (BR-REQ-060-01); the tiles' previews read the public files, which are the club's public logo. A Romanian-only poster: both languages, like every text of the backoffice.
changelogLine: - **«PR Kit» for the whole team** — a new tab in the backoffice, for every role including the volunteers: the club's logo and its mountains in the club's colour, white and black as SVG, PNG and vector PDF, six A4 sticker sheets (with a QR code to the site, or the logo alone), the A4 «Suntem pe YouTube» poster, and the club's colour for a print shop. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given any backoffice role — the desk's Voluntar, the Redactor, the Organizer, the Tehnic, an Administrator or a Superadministrator — when the backoffice draws its top bar, then «PR Kit» stands just before «Ghid» and leads to `/admin/pr-kit`, a club member is offered no section, and the page and its three download routes assert `canWorkTheDesk` on the server: without a staff session each route answers `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401), a role that may not or a colleague who owes the team's undertaking `FORBIDDEN` (403), and the page answers not found to a member; every route is a GET that writes nothing and hands out an attachment named from the club's slug with `Cache-Control: private, no-store` (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `staff/roles.test.ts`, `staff/settings-map.test.ts`, integration `pr-kit/pr-kit.test.ts`.

Given the club's lockup `public/brand/logo.svg` and its palette, when `yarn brand:assets` runs, then `public/brand/kit/` holds, named from the club's slug, the lockup and its mountains — the paths `club.json`'s `logo.mark.viewBox` shows whole — in the primary, white and black, each an SVG framed 4 % of the drawing's width outside the drawing measured from its path data, written 200 mm wide with its height, and a transparent PNG 4000 pixels wide in the ink's colour; `club/assets.lock.json` holds each file's sha256, and a lockup, a colour or a kit file changed without the script fails the tests (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `theme/brand-kit.test.ts`, `theme/brand-assets-lock.test.ts`, `pr-kit/kit.test.ts`.

Given «PR Kit», when a staff member downloads a sticker sheet, then it is one A4 PDF page drawn on request — «12 pe foaie» or «24 pe foaie» with a code, or 12, 24 or 40 of the logo alone, or 12 white on the primary — inside 9 mm side and 8 mm top and foot margins with a dashed line on every cut, each code error correction M to this site's `APP_BASE_URL` with the address printed under it without its scheme, and a quiet zone of four modules inside each sticker clear of the logo and the address for every code from version 1 up; a logo downloads as the kit's SVG and PNG unchanged and as a one-page vector PDF of the SVG's size (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `pr-kit/sheets.test.ts`, `pr-kit/code.test.ts`, integration `pr-kit/pr-kit.test.ts`.

Given «PR Kit» → «Afiș YouTube», when `CLUB_YOUTUBE_URL` is set, then the poster downloads as one A4 PDF page in the page's language — the logo, «Suntem pe», the play button and «YouTube», the lead, the code to that address in a card framed in the primary with «SCANEAZĂ-MĂ» on its edge and a quiet zone of four modules clear of the card and the tab, how to scan it, the address without its scheme and the club's hashtags — and when it is not set the route is not found and the page says in one line where the address is set (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `pr-kit/poster.test.ts`, integration `pr-kit/pr-kit.test.ts`.

Given a desk Voluntar on a 320-pixel phone or a desktop, when they open «PR Kit» from the top bar, then nothing scrolls sideways, every download is a link of at least 44 × 44 pixels, and a sticker sheet, a logo's PDF and the poster each save as a PDF named from the club's slug without leaving the page (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: e2e `pr-kit.spec.ts`.

batchLine: «PR Kit» in the backoffice for every role: logo kit, sticker sheets, YouTube poster
